title: VlaApproval
description: The approval a person gives to a proposed trajectory of the VLA engine (the answer of POST /confirmations/<id>/confirm): the fingerprint of exactly that trajectory, the robot, the operator, the moment of the approval and the moment it stops being valid, and an HMAC-SHA256 signature of those fields. The layer that executes the motion checks the signature, the fingerprint, the robot and the validity; an approval is used once and is short-lived. The schema is closed.
